name: ESNS (Eurosonic Noorderslag)
whyItMatters: ~400 festival bookers attend. ESNS acts feed the European Talent Exchange Programme (ETEP) and get picked up for Glastonbury, Roskilde, Primavera etc. Being *in the room* (even as a delegate) is worth as much as a slot.
recommendedMove: Attend as delegate. Pre-book 10–15 meetings via the ESNS networking tool. Target Afro/urban bookers, NL promoters, and streaming editors. Build relationships for a 2028 showcase application.

name: The Great Escape
whyItMatters: UK's biggest new-music industry showcase. ~450 acts, 30+ venues, 3,000 industry delegates. Strong Africa/diaspora programming in recent years. A slot here opens UK booking conversations.
recommendedMove: Apply Oct–Dec 2026 via official application portal. Simultaneously pitch UK Afro promoters directly (Colours Hoxton, EartH, Jazz Café). A booking here before TGE opens a second route in.

name: ADE (Amsterdam Dance Event)
whyItMatters: Home turf. ADE is where NL electronic music business happens — labels, agents, bookers all attend. A satellite show during ADE week is achievable and highly visible. The conference itself gives access to agent/label speed-meetings.
recommendedMove: Book a satellite show at a mid-size Amsterdam venue during ADE week. Simultaneously buy a conference pass and book 10–15 meetings. Target Afro/house-focused labels and EU booking agents.

name: SXSW Showcase
whyItMatters: Global media magnet. A SXSW slot generates US press, streaming picks, and agent interest. Best suited once there is a US label partner or music-export support (e.g. DutchCulture).
recommendedMove: Apply for 2027 via the official SXSW showcase portal (opens Sep 2026). Simultaneously contact DutchCulture and Creative Netherlands about music-export travel grants — they can co-fund the trip and boost the application.

name: Primavera Sound
whyItMatters: One of Europe's most credible indie/electronic festivals. Afro-diaspora artists increasingly on the lineup (Burna Boy, Tems, Amaarae). A slot signals international credibility.
recommendedMove: Pitch via a booking agent with an existing Primavera relationship, or send a Groover campaign targeting Primavera curators. This is a 2027–2028 goal — focus on NL/UK slots first to build the profile.

name: Sonar
whyItMatters: Premier electronic/AV festival with strong Afro/global crossover. SonarPro conference runs alongside — ideal for agent and label meetings.
recommendedMove: Submit via a booking agent who has Sonar contacts, or through a label. Attend SonarPro conference regardless — pitch meetings with EU electronic label reps and booking agents.

name: Afronation Portugal
whyItMatters: Fast-growing Afrobeats/Afro house festival — exactly Donn's genre. Strong diaspora audience. A slot here positions Donn in the international Afro circuit.
recommendedMove: Pitch via a booking agent with an Afronation relationship, or contact the programming team directly once an agent is on board. This is a realistic 2027 target if the summer 2026 gig count is strong.

name: Woo Hah!
whyItMatters: NL hip-hop/urban festival with growing Afro-crossover lineup. Home market. A slot here is visible to NL press and booking community.
recommendedMove: Pitch via a NL urban/Afro booking agent once confirmed bookings support the ask. Follow the booking announcement cycle — applications typically go through agents in Q1.

name: Kwaku Summer Festival
artistApplication: Organiser direct or via NL Afro booker
whyItMatters: Flagship Afro/Caribbean community festival in Amsterdam. Very high genre fit. Strong community credibility — a slot here matters to the NL Afro scene as much as any commercial festival.
recommendedMove: Contact the organisation directly (Kwaku Foundation) — this is a community event where a direct personal approach works. Have gig references and community ties ready. Early contact preferred.

name: Lowlands
whyItMatters: Biggest Dutch multi-genre festival. Aspirational for 2027–2028 once profile is established. A slot here is the NL mainstream breakthrough moment.
recommendedMove: Secure a NL booking agent first — Lowlands books exclusively via agents. Focus on building profile and smaller NL festival slots in 2027 as stepping stones. Target 2028 application.
